points: There was a famine in the land, and Elimelech of Bethlehemjudah went to sojourn in the country of Moab with his wife Naomi and his two sons Mahlon and Chilion, Ephrathites of Bethlehemjudah.

note.label: Ruth 1: Naomi and Ruth Return from Moab

points: This is a trial at the gate before ten elders over the land of Elimelech, Mahlon and Chilion, dead with no heir; the nearest kinsman must take it up.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah

points: Boaz bought all that was Elimelech's, Chilion's and Mahlon's, and purchased Ruth to be his wife to raise up the name of the dead, that it be not cut off from among his brethren.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah

points: Boaz said unto the elders and unto all the people, Ye are witnesses this day that I have bought all that was Elimelech's, and all that was Chilion's and Mahlon's, of the hand of Naomi; moreover Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of Mahlon, have I purchased to be my wife, to raise up the name of the dead upon his inheritance, that the name of the dead be not cut off from among his brethren, and from the gate of his place.
